basic_details.job_title: NBT Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for Consultant, Content Writer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: National Book Trust (NBT) Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by the National Book Trust (NBT) on its official website for the recruitment of 5 Consultant Grade-II (For Exhibition), Consultant Grade-I (For Exhibition), Literary Festival Curator, Cultural Curator (Events & Exhibition), and Content Writer posts under Advertisement No. 116/2026/Estt.. This recruitment offers an excellent opportunity for experienced professionals seeking contract-based government jobs.

age_limit.details: All Posts: Maximum age limit is 50 years.

qualification.education_qualification: Master's degree in relevant subject, Bachelor's degree in literature/humanities/social sciences, Graduation in Mass communication/humanities, Post Graduate in relevant field
qualification.details: Consultant Grade-II (For Exhibition): Master's degree in a relevant subject or a degree earned after 4 years of study post 10+2. More than 15 years of experience as Project Incharge in literary festivals, ideation, conceptualization of literary sessions, outreach, coordination with authors/speakers, brochure creation, branding, event management, and organizing large-scale B2C, B2B, and international events. Fluency in English and Hindi is required. Consultant Grade-I (For Exhibition): Master's degree in a relevant subject or a degree earned after 4 years of study post 10+2. More than 10 years of experience as Project Incharge or in a supervisory capacity in literary festivals, ideation, conceptualization of literary sessions, outreach, coordination with authors/speakers, brochure creation, branding, event management, and organizing large-scale B2C, B2B, and international events. Fluency in English and Hindi is required. Literary Festival Curator: Bachelor's degree, preferably in literature/humanities/social sciences. 5-7 years of experience in literary event/event planning management, book events, and knowledge of the publishing industry. Understanding of India's multi-lingual literary landscape and excellent communication skills are essential. Cultural Curator (Events & Exhibition): Graduation in Mass Communication/Humanities or a related discipline. Minimum 5-7 years of experience in curation, programming, or coordination of cultural events/festivals, exhibitions, or public programs in a government organization, cultural institution, or reputed organization. Experience working with artists, authors, performers, and cultural speakers is required. Content Writer: Post Graduate in a relevant field from a recognized university with good knowledge of English. Minimum 2 years of proven work experience in digital content writing & metadata creation aligned with SEO best practices, press releases, and articles. Ability to create high-quality descriptions, summaries, and promotional blurbs for e-books.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for NBT Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.nbtindia.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 01-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NBT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the NBT Recruitment 2026 is 01 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the NBT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 5 vacancies are available for various posts, including Consultant Grade-II (For Exhibition), Consultant Grade-I (For Exhibition), Literary Festival Curator, Cultural Curator (Events & Exhibition), and Content Writer.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Consultant Grade-II (For Exhibition) post?
faq.answer: For the Consultant Grade-II (For Exhibition) post, candidates need a Master's degree in a relevant subject or a degree earned after 4 years of study post 10+2, along with extensive experience in event management and literary festivals.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the posts advertised by NBT?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts advertised by the National Book Trust is 50 years. There are no specific minimum age limits mentioned for most of the roles.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for NBT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for the NBT Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these NBT posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the advertised posts in the National Book Trust Recruitment 2026 will be based on an Interview. Candidates shortlisted based on their applications will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary range for the Content Writer position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Content Writer position ranges from Rs. 40,000/- to Rs. 50,000/- per month. This is a contract-based role.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates apply through online mode for NBT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for the NBT Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it via post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q9. What kind of experience is required for the Literary Festival Curator role?
faq.answer: The Literary Festival Curator role requires 5-7 years of experience in literary event/event planning management, book events, and knowledge of the publishing industry. Understanding of India's literary landscape is also important.

faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the National Book Trust, which is www.nbtindia.gov.in. Ensure you download the correct documents from the official source.
